comments.text:
​As a person who had no discipline, I know it doesn't work like that. You won't wake up one day and magically become so obsessed with getting better at life that you work really hard for it every day. If you try that, in a couple of days you will notice nothing has changed, and you will end up right back where you started, but with less hope for yourself this time.
​Instead of that, you can make simple and easy changes in your life that you won't even notice at first. Something like reading 2 pages a day or getting your gym equipment ready. When you start doing this unconsciously, it's time to do a bit more. And when you repeat this process again and again, you will get closer to the person you want to become.
​Remember, it's all about showing up, because 1 is always greater than 0. Also, don't compare yourself to others..
